_comment: CARD-RENDER-AUDIT baselines — recorded 2026-07-28 (corpus max_id=14245) from the two deterministic windows the scanner renders: mod14 (id%14==0, n=1016) and latest500 (id>max_id-500, n~460). Ceiling classes are ingest artefacts we live with: the check WARNS only when a rate rises past baseline+tol — the null-verdict-fossil / spine-artifact growth pattern. tol is roughly 3-5x the binomial sigma of the rate at the window's n, so deterministic drift noise never trips it but a systemic increase does; latest500 tolerances are wider because its n is smaller and its content mix moves with the news cycle. snake_case_identifier moved to the scanner's ZERO list on 2026-07-29 (DISPLAY-LEAK-FIX-2 laundered the possible_redirect / news_context / primary_source / fact_check residue). card_face_truncation was added straight to the ZERO list on 2026-07-29 (CARD-TRUNCATION-FIX): the pre-fix rate was 57.9% of mod14 / 56.6% of latest500 faces cut by the old hard 115-char slice with NO ellipsis, 33.6% / 31.0% of them severed mid-eojeol (id 13700), and the fix drives both to 0 — so a recurrence is a regression, not a ceiling. Zero classes are enforced in scripts/card_render_audit.js and are deliberately not listed here: they must be zero, always, in every window.

latest500._note: bullet_char is SATURATED in this window (recent ingest is press-release-heavy); it cannot meaningfully grow here, so its growth signal is the mod14 window's job

hero_restates_title._reason: RE-RECORDED 2026-08-05 (corpus max_id=14856), from 0.082 measured 2026-07-28. This is a MEASUREMENT, not a concession — the detector was not touched and the tolerance was NOT widened. Mechanism: a composition shift in the ingest, not a change in hero selection. Rows whose STORED title ends in an appended outlet name ('… - 뉴스1', '… - go.seoul.co.kr') went from 3.3% of the mod14 history to 15.7% of the previous 1000 rows to 22.0% of latest500, and those rows fire this class at ~35% because such articles are aggregator/announcement stubs whose body yields no claim, so the hero falls back to the headline. BOTH sub-rates held flat across every window: tail-titled ~35%, non-tail-titled ~6.5% (6.5% / 5.8% / 6.7%). The stored number is that fixed pair evaluated at the CURRENT tail share: 0.220*0.35 + 0.780*0.065 = 0.128, which equals the direct reading (64/500 = 12.8%) to the digit — the agreement is the evidence that only the mix moved. The honest invariant is the PAIR, not this single percentage, but the checker compares one measured rate per class per window, so a single number must be stored; it will go stale again whenever the tail share moves, and re-deriving it is a re-measurement rather than a finding. WHAT MAKES IT A DEFECT AGAIN: stratify before concluding. If a future exceedance comes with the tail share still rising while the two sub-rates hold, it is the same composition story and this number is simply stale. If either SUB-RATE rises — non-tail past ~6.5% or tail past ~35% — hero selection itself has degraded and that IS a defect, no matter what the headline percentage says. KNOWN LIMIT (deliberately not fixed, its own decision): the check compares the hero against the RAW stored title while the reader sees the outlet-tail-stripped one, so it UNDER-counts — 10 further latest500 cards restate the title a reader actually sees without firing, putting the reader-facing rate near 14.8% against the 12.8% recorded here. The mod14 baseline is left at 0.063: it measured 7.1%, inside its own tolerance, so nothing was exceeded there and moving it would only desensitise the long-window signal.

hero_clamp._comment: HERO-CLAMP (2026-07-31). The hero summary is clipped by CSS, not JS. Measured in a real browser over the newest 300 card-face summaries at the shipped budget: max 2 wrapped lines at 1440x900 (hero summary 912px wide) and max 4 at 390x844 (362px wide), so 0 of 300 were clipped at clamp=4 at either viewport. The check reads both constants from the files that own them (clamp from frontend/styles/main.css, budget from CARD_FACE_MAX_CHARS in frontend/scripts/main.js) and fails if the clamp SHRINKS below this baseline or the budget GROWS above it, either of which would let the clamp start cutting mid-phrase again.
